hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; if [ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false' 2>/dev/null)" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ -n "$ANDROID_HOME" ] || grep -qs '^sdk.dir=' local.properties; then out=$(./gradlew -q lintDebug 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | tail -40 1>&2; exit 2; }; else echo 'lintDebug skipped: no Android SDK ($ANDROID_HOME unset, no sdk.dir in local.properties)' >&2; fi
